text:
taylor: Heads-up — saw sustained queue growth on Dedicated pool for llm-group 'llama3q' during the 09:00-09:20 UTC canary. Latency spikes correlated with runtime 3.3 alpha; rolling back to propose a temporary pin to runtime 3.2 until we triage.

morgan: Ack. Do we have a clear repro or is it load-only? Any logs to point at kernel/regression?

taylor: Mostly appears under burst traffic patterns. KV-cache miss rate jumped ~3x in traces. Not a full repro locally yet.

sri_k: Can we do a fast mitigation: pin-inflight + throttle autoscale? Deploy-bot can apply a pin on model-routing if we give the window.

eva: Agree pin + throttle. Also want a short blameless postmortem if the regression is in runtime scheduling.

benji: If we pin, we should set an automatic unpin deadline and a rollback playbook in case it causes other regressions (long-queue for other model groups).

taylor: Proposed command to run now (canary window):

```
/deploy pin-runtime --runtime runtime-3.2 --model-group llama3q --until 2026-03-20T16:00Z --reason "canary queue pressure"
```

morgan: +1 to the command. Also add a conservative concurrency cap on the pool while triaging: `pool.max_concurrency=40` for the group.

sri_k: I'll prepare a minimal tracing dashboard and share snapshot. If KD cache behavior is the issue, we should surface sequence length distribution too.

eva: Please add a canary label so we can track requests routed to the pinned runtime vs fallback. Tag: `experiment=pinback_pressure_test`.

taylor: I'll run the pin and set the pool cap. After pin we should watch 10m rolling metrics then decide to keep/unpin.

deploy-bot: Received pin request from taylor. Validating permissions...

deploy-bot: Pin action applied by taylor: runtime=runtime-3.2 model_group=llama3q until=2026-03-20T16:00Z reason="canary queue pressure". Change-id: chg_3412345670

oncall-bot: Alert -> Notifying oncall channel #eng-oncall; severity: monitor-only. Summary: pinned runtime for llama3q due to queue pressure (see chg_3412345670).

benji: Confirmed metrics look less spiky after pin + cap. KV-cache miss rate down ~60% in first 8min.

morgan: Ok lets keep for the triage window. Action items: 1) sri_k to run trace diff + heap profiles; 2) eng-runtime to review scheduler commit range between 3.2 and 3.3; 3) decide unpin by 15:45 UTC or extend with a rollback plan.

sri_k: On it. Pushing initial trace diffs to the shared runbook: https://internal.redwood/triage/llama3q-pinback-3412345670

taylor: Thanks. If anyone sees impact to other model groups ping me immediately. :thumbsup:

morgan: For the rollback decision, recommend we script an automated rollback command that flips routing back to 3.3 canary if we detect improved latency over a 5m stable window. Draft:

```
/deploy auto-unpin --if-stable 5m --metric p50_latency --threshold 1.15 --target runtime-3.3 --change-ref chg_3412345670
```

taylor: Good idea. We'll hold manual control for now but keep the script ready.

deploy-bot: Note: chg_3412345670 now linked to release notes draft: /releases/drafts/3412345670-pinback.md

benji: Adding a small note for Customer Success in case any dedicated customers see routing changes.

eva: Will draft a short internal summary and add to the postmortem checklist.

taylor: Closing loop for now — monitoring. Will post final unpin or extend decision before 15:45 UTC.
